usage.callShape: POST https://x402.quickintel.io/v1/scan/full with JSON body {chain, tokenAddress}
usage.outputShape: body.tokenDetails (tokenName, tokenSymbol, tokenOwner, tokenSupply); body.tokenDynamicDetails.is_Honeypot, .buy_Tax, .sell_Tax, .lp_Burned_Percent, .liquidity; body.quickiAudit.* (can_Mint, can_Blacklist, can_Pause_Trading, contract_Renounced, is_Proxy, has_Scams, hidden_Owner, etc.); body.isScam; body.contractVerified
quirks: inputSchema was null in the registry; body shape {chain, tokenAddress} inferred and confirmed working
chain is a lowercase slug like 'base' (also supports 60+ chains/Solana per description)
response is large (~7.8KB) and quickiAudit may embed raw contract source code in hidden_Owner_Modifiers/external_Functions fields
honeypot/tax/scam booleans can be null when not applicable (e.g. isScam:null) — treat null as 'unknown', not safe
usage.guide: POST a JSON body {chain, tokenAddress} to https://x402.quickintel.io/v1/scan/full where chain is a lowercase network slug (e.g. "base") and tokenAddress is the token contract address. It is a first-party x402 endpoint on Base — pay ~$0.03 USDC per scan, returns synchronously with a 200. Read the security verdict from body.tokenDynamicDetails.is_Honeypot, buy_Tax/sell_Tax, and the body.quickiAudit booleans (can_Mint, can_Blacklist, can_Pause_Trading, contract_Renounced, is_Proxy, has_Scams). Note that some fields (isScam, *_Renounced) may be null meaning "unknown" rather than safe.
